label: late input k (pos 7-8) in long sequences starting with f/x/j; weaker on following <DEL>
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.015% of steps), only in long sequences (L=8-9, t=5-9) and never in the copy phase. About 62% of activation mass is on input k at original positions 7-8 (usually the last or second-to-last original token); the other ~26% is on the <DEL> step, usually weaker, mostly when the sequence starts with f (also x or j). The first token strongly gates firing: lift is 16x for first_tok f, and 4x / 3x for x / j. Late k on its own has precision of only 5%, and adding the f/x/j first-token condition raises that to 32%. On dev the predicate gets F1 0.29 and mass recall 0.43. The strongest activation (max 3.56) was k at position 7 in a sequence starting f x, which also lit up the following <DEL>. Top activations are mostly k as the last original token. Many weak activations sit on <DEL> or on other late letters (l, a, n, w, p) in f-initial length-8/9 sequences, and these are not captured. Does not fire at t<5, in the copy phase, or for L<=6. The full condition is unresolved and seems to depend on more of the sequence history.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=f (+5.61), orig0=x (+3.58), phase=0 & in_tok=k (+3.40), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=k (+3.40), prev_tok=q (+3.08), orig0=j (+3.03). Lower it: phase=2 (-5.34), next_out=- (-4.09), orig7=- (-2.47), orig8=- (-2.36).
